title: TAMIU and Laredo College to Hold December Commencement Ceremonies
excerpt: Texas A&M International University will hold its Fall 2026 commencement Thursday, Dec. 10, at Sames Auto Arena, and Laredo College has its graduation tentatively set for Friday, Dec. 18, at the same venue.
content:
Texas A&M International University will hold its Fall 2026 commencement on Thursday, Dec. 10, at Sames Auto Arena, and Laredo College has its fall graduation tentatively set for Friday, Dec. 18, at the same venue, according to the schools.

TAMIU will hold two ceremonies on Dec. 10, the university says: the College of Arts and Sciences at 10 a.m., and the A.R. Sanchez, Jr. School of Business, the College of Education, and the College of Nursing and Health Sciences at 3 p.m.

Graduating Dustdevils can also attend a Milestone Mingle on Tuesday, Dec. 9, from 4 to 7 p.m. on campus, where participating students receive a free patch for their graduation stole.

At Laredo College, admission to the ceremony is free and seating is first come, first served, with no tickets required for guests, according to the college. Graduating students must enter Sames Auto Arena through Gate D and line up an hour before the ceremony in cap and gown. Diplomas will be ready for pickup 10 business days after the ceremony.

KGNS reported Nov. 23 that both schools are hosting commencement ceremonies in December.

Sources: Texas A&M International University commencement information; Laredo College graduation information and 2026–2027 academic calendar; KGNS, Nov. 23, 2026.
